questions.subject: Maths
questions.prompt: A triangle has a base of 16 cm and a height of 9 cm. Slow down and work through it step by step: what is its area?
questions.why: Area = ½ × base × height = ½ × 16 × 9 = 72 cm². Halve first, then multiply — don't skip the ½.

questions.subject: English
questions.prompt: What is a central theme of Lord of the Flies?
questions.why: The boys start out civilised but descend into savagery — Golding shows how easily order breaks down without society's rules.

questions.subject: Science
questions.prompt: What type of white blood cell produces antibodies to target a specific pathogen?
questions.why: Lymphocytes produce antibodies that lock onto a specific pathogen, unlike phagocytes which engulf pathogens generally.

questions.subject: History
questions.prompt: Order these events of the Munich Putsch
sequence: Hitler declares a national revolution in the beer hall
Police open fire on the marchers
Hitler is arrested and put on trial
questions.why: The putsch began with Hitler's beer hall declaration, moved to the street march, was stopped by police gunfire, and ended with Hitler's arrest and trial.

questions.subject: D&T
questions.prompt: A market stall keeps the same logo, colours and packaging on every product for a whole year. What is this mainly building?
questions.why: Consistent branding builds recognition, so customers spot the stall instantly — that's the marketing point, not price, size, or supply chains, which are unrelated business factors.
